sloka: एवं न विद्यते रूपं गतासूनां विशाम्पते ।दीर्घायुषस्तु ये मर्त्यास्तेषां तु मुखमीद्दशम् ।। ६.१०२.१७ ।।
transliteration: evaṁ na vidyate rūpaṁ gatāsūnāṁ viśāmpate ।dīrghāyuṣastu ye martyāsteṣāṁ tu mukhamīddaśam ।। 6.102.17 ।।

translations.english: 'Wives can be found everywhere, relatives can be found everywhere but biological sibling brothers are not found in any place.'
